session_mesgs.notes: One per file. Cadence fields are half-cadence: spm = (value + fractional) * 2. Positions are semicircles: deg = raw * 180 / 2^31. training_load_peak is Garmin load scalar.

lap_mesgs.notes: Same field vocabulary as session at lap grain; message_index is the lap index. Strap fields (avg_stance_time_balance, avg_stance_time_percent, enhanced_avg/max_respiration_rate) extracted when present.

record_mesgs.notes: ~1/sec. Sparser channels (stance_time, step_length, vertical_*) must preserve positional nulls. Fields 90/137/138 are undocumented numeric FIT fields the SDK exposes as int dict keys (msg.get(137) etc.), not named fields.

fields_undocumented_numeric.137: stamina potential (0-100 int; the ceiling — always >= field 138; declines ~monotonically over the run). Validated 2026-07-11 against 3 Garmin Connect activities (Jun 27, Jul 5, Jul 10), 9/9 anchor values (begin/end/min) exact.
fields_undocumented_numeric.138: stamina (0-100 int; dips first under effort, recovers back toward potential). Session-level Beginning/Ending Potential (from 137) and Min Stamina (from 138) match Connect's Stats-panel Stamina group exactly. Validated 2026-07-11, 9/9 anchors exact.
fields_undocumented_numeric.90: performance condition (small int, roughly ±10, delta from baseline fitness). SPARSE: absent for the first ~6-8min while Garmin baselines, then ~1/sec. Validated 2026-07-11 against Connect's Performance Condition chart tooltips.

fields_undocumented.134: strap-era only; unknown (observed in strap runs; 100 in probe)
fields_undocumented.144: strap-era only; unknown (observed in strap runs; 84 in probe)

time_in_zone_mesgs.notes: Filter reference_mesg == 'session'. power_zone_high_boundary has trailing nulls to strip.

split_mesgs.notes: Run/walk detection: split_type rwd_run|rwd_walk|rwd_stand with start_time/end_time. Other split types ignored.

device_info_mesgs.notes: HR source detection: non-local entry with ble_device_type or antplus_device_type == 'heart_rate' => chest strap (capture serial_number, battery_status); else wrist optical when HR present.

activity_mesgs.notes: local_timestamp - timestamp = UTC offset fallback when the JSON sidecar is missing.

json_sidecar.notes: Connect summary next to each FIT: activityId, activityName, startTimeGMT/startTimeLocal (offset source), movingDuration, vO2MaxValue, avgGradeAdjustedSpeed, TE messages/label, differenceBodyBattery, steps, intensity minutes.
